label: Boxed property inclusion transmits limitation backward at the selected world
paraphrase: At selected w, for every pair of properties Phi/Psi, boxed universal inclusion from Phi to Psi together with the SAME classifier marking Psi limiting implies that it marks Phi limiting. This is explicit backwards closure over the existing constant-domain Property/Box semantics, not Scott complement exclusion or a selected full existential-deficiency definition.
